title: The Alignment Preservation Efficacy of Weight-Space Regularization During Fine-Tuning
original_idea: Fine-tune an aligned model on a domain task with and without L2 regularization toward the pre-fine-tuning weights. Vary regularization strength. Measure task performance and alignment probe scores across regularization strengths. Identify the Pareto frontier.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Strong chain: L2 regularization penalizes weight movement -> alignment-relevant weights preserved -> alignment retained during domain FT. The deliverable (Pareto frontier of task performance vs alignment) is independently valuable and immediately actionable.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: L2 regularization is a standard, well-documented technique. Fine-tuning with regularization is supported in standard frameworks. Methodology is straightforward: vary lambda, measure two metrics. Intermediate and accessible with guidance.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused first deliverable: one model, one domain task, vary regularization strength, plot task performance vs alignment score. The Pareto frontier is a clean, self-contained result achievable within 30 hours.
